description: FEBE (Federation de l'Industrie du Beton), 'Standardisation des poutres prefabriquees en beton precontraint pour ouvrages d'art', 4th ed. 2017: I-sections h = 900-2050 mm in 50 mm steps, two sub-families. Designation convention h/b (e.g. 900/620, 2050/880). The FEBE drawing labels b on BOTH flanges (symmetric I, per Ergon's 2018 reproduction). Governing standard for precast prestressed bridge beams in Wallonia (CCT Qualiroutes K.7.1).

sources.defining_document: FEBE brochure 4th ed. 2017 - PDF at https://www.febe.be/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/FEBE_Standardisation-Poutres-Prefabriquees-pour-Ouvrages-dart_4e-editon-2017_sec.pdf (HTTP 403 to automated fetchers - open in a browser)
sources.independent_confirmation: Ergon nv Guide technique 2018, section 4.1 (https://www.ergon.be/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/04_ERG2018_TG_Ouvrages-d%E2%80%99art_FR.pdf) - reproduces the FEBE standard sections with the same numbers

evidence_levels.widths_and_pairings: attested (FEBE brochure structure cross-checked against Ergon Guide technique 2018)
evidence_levels.gorge_g: attested (pairs with b: g = b - 240 small / b - 320 large)
evidence_levels.m_cycle: SEARCH-ATTESTED ONLY: m cycles 150->200->250->300->150 across successive 50 mm height steps (e.g. 900/620 m=150; 2050/880 m=300); letter-to-dimension mapping for m/n/r/s is UNVERIFIED (requires the FEBE drawing)
evidence_levels.flange_thicknesses: NOT PUBLISHED in open sources - required constructor arguments (top/bottom); hints for 2050/880 only: top-associated 300, bottom-associated 210 (search-attested)
